description: Run this solet's own guarded deploy rule: the same deploy-by-rule a landing owner asks for after it lands the solet's repository, and that a person can ask for. Without attempt_id the verb starts the rule as a detached process of the solet's checkout, or attaches to the attempt already running, and answers at once with outcome 'deferred', decision 'in_progress' and an attempt_id. The rule takes the deploy lock and host admission, waits for a running gate battery or swap, moves the solet to master's release by a blue-green swap, verifies it and records the deployment in the solet's own records. On failure it keeps the old release serving and sends its needs-a-person notice. With attempt_id the verb only reads that attempt: still in progress, or its terminal outcome (deployed, skipped, deferred or failed) with the rule's own receipt. trigger 'landing' (default) skips a master move that changed no production path; 'tick' deploys master whatever changed. No schedule or heartbeat starts it. The caller in the start log line is built by the server, for attribution only.
embedding_description: Deploy this solet's master now by its own guarded deploy rule: start the blue-green deploy detached after a landing, or read a deploy attempt's outcome later by its attempt id (deployed, skipped, deferred or failed). Used by the landing owner after it lands the solet's repository, and by a person.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with outcome ('deployed', 'skipped', 'deferred' or 'failed'), decision (the rule's own decision such as deployed, already_current, deferred_gate or failed, or in_progress, attempt_abandoned or start_failed), attempt_id (the id to read the attempt back by, or null when none started), target (the full master sha the attempt deploys), child_pid (the detached rule process, or null), receipt (the rule's terminal receipt once it has finished, else null) and detail (bounded failure text, else null).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with outcome and decision. For in_progress give the attempt_id and child_pid and say the deploy continues on its own. For deployed name the target's short sha and the release from the receipt. For deferred or failed quote the decision and detail.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: After decision in_progress, call again later with the same attempt_id to read the terminal outcome; do not start another attempt to check on it. After a deferred decision of the rule, a new call without attempt_id runs the rule again. A failed outcome needs a person; the rule has already sent its notice and kept the old release serving. read_deployments shows what is recorded as deployed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Starting or reading an attempt of this solet's own deploy rule, which runs from the solet's checkout
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: solet_mismatch: solet_name is not this solet. invalid_trigger: trigger is not landing or tick. invalid_argument: attempt_id is not an id this verb answered. unknown_attempt: that attempt is not among the newest 20 kept. deploy_rule_unconfigured: APP_HOME is unset, or the checkout above it lacks .venv/bin/python3, .venv/bin/solet-bridge or the rule script. The code is in data.error_code and prefixes the error text.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For solet_mismatch, call the named solet's own bridge. For invalid_trigger or invalid_argument, fix the named parameter. For unknown_attempt, read read_deployments for what is deployed, then call without attempt_id to run the rule again. For deploy_rule_unconfigured, the solet has to run from a checkout with its .venv; fix the installation, not the call.
